## Problem

What problem does this feature solve? Who is affected?

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature you would like. Be specific — include API design if relevant.

```bash
# Example of how you imagine it would work
GET /v1/i/image-id?remove-bg=true
```

## Alternatives considered

What other solutions did you think about? Why does this one win?

## Does this belong in Imgo core?

Imgo aims to stay focused. Explain why this should be a built-in feature rather than something handled outside Imgo (e.g., pre-processing before upload).

## Additional context

Links, screenshots, or references to similar features in other tools.
